image_description: A street scene featuring a vintage black truck in the foreground carrying two spare tires in its bed. The truck has red spoked wheels with whitewall tires. To the left is a red and white vintage car, also with spoked wheels. In the background, there is a modern blue sedan and pedestrians on a sidewalk near brick buildings.
